message: No {0} matching {2} was found for the {1} '{3}'.
title: Required member not found.
rationale: The current text attaches the member name to the command ('matching the command 'DoesNotExist''), although {2} is the configured name or pattern of the missing member and {1} is the kind of generated artifact. The title says 'Optional', but DiagnosticReporter.ReportDiagnostics reports NotFound only when the member is required (explicitly configured or required by the naming convention).
codeChange: {0} is always 'can-execute method or can-execute property' for commands (static _canExecuteCategories in CommandNamingConventionMatch), even when only CanExecuteMethod or only CanExecuteProperty is set and only methods or only properties are searched; passing only the searched categories would make the message precise.
